name: mimg_list_generations
description: List the user's recent generations, newest first, each with its prompt, mode, status, credits charged, and images (`id`, `url`, `seed`). Optional: `limit` (1-200, default 50), `before` (an ISO-8601 timestamp — pass the `created_at` of the last row you saw to page further back; the response carries `next_before` while more remain), and `mode` ('text-to-image' or 'image-to-image'). Read-only and free. Also the RECOVERY path: if a generate or edit call timed out, list here to find whether the image was in fact produced — never re-run the generation, which would charge the user twice.

before.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; return only generations created before it.
